title: RewardsClaimed fires even when the value was banked rather than paid
description: RewardsClaimed(user, pendingPhUSDAmount, pendingRewardAmount) is emitted at :939 whenever either amount is non-zero -- INCLUDING when that value was BANKED rather than DELIVERED. An indexer therefore sees BOTH RewardsClaimed AND PhUSDMintFailed / StableClaimFailed for the same value, and may double-count distributed rewards. Pre-existing for the stable leg; story-031 extends the ambiguity to phUSD.
impact: Off-chain double-count only. On-chain accounting is CORRECT -- the event is indexed by user (whose accrued rewards were drained), matching V1 semantics, and the banked amounts are tracked separately.
recommendation: Either emit RewardsClaimed with the amounts actually DELIVERED, or document that RewardsClaimed means 'settled (paid OR banked)' and that reconciling it requires netting off the corresponding *Failed events.
severityRationale: QA. Off-chain observability only; on-chain accounting correct.

doNotCollapse.Q-01: Both are observability findings on the same leg, but distinct root causes: Q-01 discards the revert REASON; Q-05 emits a MISLEADING success event.
